caveat: Metadata came from the journal's online-first list; the abstract was not read, so the inclusion criteria and what the review counts as participation are unverified.
title: Art-science collaboration for sustainability challenges: a systematic review of scholarship, sustainability framings, and stakeholder participation
why: Reviews how art-science work frames sustainability and who actually gets to take part. A route into the material and aesthetic register you want for substrate, and for public-space work with residents.
